recipes.name: Authelia
recipes.description: An authentication portal for a separate reverse proxy. Configure the proxy to use Authelia forward authentication.

command:
umask 077
case "$COOKIE_DOMAIN" in ''|*[!a-zA-Z0-9.-]*) exit 1;; esac
case "$AUTH_HOST" in ''|*[!a-zA-Z0-9.-]*) exit 1;; esac
case "$ADMIN_NAME" in ''|*[!a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*) exit 1;; esac
case "$PASSWORD_HASH" in '$argon2id$'*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac
cat > /config/configuration.yml <<EOF
server:
  address: tcp://:9091/
authentication_backend:
  file:
    path: /config/users.yml
access_control:
  default_policy: one_factor
session:
  cookies:
    - domain: "$COOKIE_DOMAIN"
      authelia_url: "https://$AUTH_HOST"
storage:
  local:
    path: /config/db.sqlite3
notifier:
  filesystem:
    filename: /config/notification.txt
EOF
printf 'users:\n  "%s":\n    password: "%s"\n    displayname: "%s"\n' "$ADMIN_NAME" "$PASSWORD_HASH" "$ADMIN_NAME" > /config/users.yml
exec /app/entrypoint.sh --config /config/configuration.yml

recipes.name: Traefik
recipes.description: Proxy requests to a configured HTTP upstream and inspect routes in a password-protected dashboard.

command:
cat > /tmp/dynamic.yml <<'EOF'
http:
  routers:
    dashboard:
      entryPoints: [dashboard]
      rule: PathPrefix(`/dashboard`) || PathPrefix(`/api`)
      service: api@internal
      middlewares: [dashboard-auth]
    proxy:
      entryPoints: [web]
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      service: upstream
  middlewares:
    dashboard-auth:
      basicAuth:
        users:
          - {{ env "DASHBOARD_AUTH" | quote }}
  services:
    upstream:
      loadBalancer:
        passHostHeader: false
        servers:
          - url: {{ env "UPSTREAM" | quote }}
EOF
exec traefik --api.dashboard=true --entrypoints.dashboard.address=:8080 --entrypoints.web.address=:8000 --providers.file.filename=/tmp/dynamic.yml

upstream.description: An HTTP or HTTPS URL reachable from the proxy container.

dashboard_auth.title: Dashboard authentication
dashboard_auth.description: Enter a username:bcrypt-hash line generated by htpasswd.
